people.name: Chaldea
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian empire; known for astrology and wisdom

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

people.name: Zedekiah
people.line: Last king of Judah before the Babylonian exile

translations.web: Zedekiah the king said to Jeremiah, “I am afraid of the Jews who have defected to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.”
translations.bsb: But King Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, “I am afraid of the Jews who have deserted to the Chaldeans, for the Chaldeans may deliver me into their hands to abuse me.”
translations.kjv: And Zedekiah the king said unto Jeremiah, I am afraid of the Jews that are fallen to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock
translations.asv: And Zedekiah the king said unto Jeremiah, I am afraid of the Jews that are fallen away to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.
